uvular: Of or pertaining to a uvula.
uvulatome: An instrument for removing the uvula.
uvic: Pertaining to, or obtained from, grapes; specifically, designating an organic acid, C7H8O3 (also called pyrotritartaric acid), obtained as a white crystalline substance by the decomposition of tartaric and pyrotartaric acids.
uvitonic: Pertaining to, or designating, an acid which is obtained as a white crystalline substance by the action of ammonia on pyrotartaric acid.
uvea: The posterior pigmented layer of the iris; -- sometimes applied to the whole iris together with the choroid coat.
uvula: The pendent fleshy lobe in the middle of the posterior border of the soft palate. Note: The term is also applied to a somewhat similar lobe on the under side of the cerebellum and to another on the inner surface of the neck of the bladder.
uvulatomy: The operation of removing the uvula.
uva: A small pulpy or juicy fruit containing several seeds and having a thin skin, as a grape.
uvitic: Pertaining to, or designating, an acid, CH3C6H3(CO2H)2, obtained as a white crystalline substance by the partial oxidation of mesitylene; -- called also mesitic acid.
